unlisted_practices: Training diagnostic LLM agents with multi-turn reinforcement learning in a world-model virtual clinical environment
Rubric-based process-oriented evaluation of interactive diagnostic trajectories

screen.reason: The paper introduces a world-model-based virtual clinical simulation environment (DiagGym), an RL-trained diagnostic agent (DiagAgent), and a multi-turn evaluation benchmark (DiagBench) to evaluate interactive diagnostic trajectories. It tests model development and benchmark performance rather than health care organizational deployment practices or guardrails.
